issues.summary: shopifyWeeklyPull_impl_ writes only summary.grossSales and discards the excluded{} buckets, so a single small refund silently removes an entire order from the weekly Roastery online revenue figure. The Order-app contract (LEIBLE_Order_app/docs/shopify-sales-api.md 7.1.2) states this in terms: 'A $400 order refunded $5 removes $400 from the week, not $5 - deliberate, not a bug', and carries excluded.byStatus[*].gross / excluded.cancelled.gross 'precisely so the resulting shrink can be reconciled'. Nothing in the collector reads, logs or banners those buckets. docs/schema.md's new shopify_orderapp note and PRD-10 only claim 'settling orders self-correct via Summary upsert', which covers PENDING->PAID but not the refund/cancel shrink; past the 4-week repull window the shrunken figure also freezes permanently. Fix: at minimum log excluded.byStatusTotals/cancelled per week and document the metric limit in docs/schema.md; better, surface it the way PRD-8 mandates for the sibling shopSpend warnings.

greenBeanFetchAllRows_ reads only res.body.rows and meta.paging and throws away every data-quality signal the greenBeanCost API returns: diagnostics.warnings, diagnostics.dataQuality and the per-row flags[]. Upstream (LEIBLE_Order_app/Engine_CostApi.js:474) coerces a non-numeric PriceKg or TotalKg to 0 and only records it as a flag/counter, and Engine_CostApi.js:540-556 silently drops rows whose Timestamp is not a valid date, reporting it solely via warnings[]. Consequence: a typo'd price cell in 06_Stock_Intake ingests as a $0 committed-spend line, the greenbean invoice total is understated, Summary under-reports Roastery COGS, and no log, alert or banner exists anywhere in the hub. The request also sends include=rows only, so summary is null and no automatic cross-foot against the API's own grand total is possible. This is inconsistent with the project's own precedent for the sibling API (PRD-8: mandatory banners for warnings[]).

cleanupOnlineRevenueSummaryRows matches kind='revenue' AND location='online' source-blind, which is byte-for-byte the shape of the Summary rows shopifyWeeklyPull now writes (kind='revenue', location='online', supplier='shopify_orderapp'). Its apply pass deletes them; because no Revenue rows back shopify_orderapp, those weeks come back resummarizable:false and runOnlineRevenueResummarize regenerates nothing - the figure survives only in Summary_online_revenue_backup. The phase added the colliding rows but added no code guard; the sole mitigation is prose in TODO.md ('Pre-phase gate ... BLOCKING, deadline Mon 2026-08-10'). A one-line supplier !== SHOPIFY_ORDERAPP_SOURCE exclusion in the match predicate would make the ordering hazard structurally impossible instead of deadline-dependent.

The section '### Shopify bring-up - teed up for next session' is still live under '## Active' with open checkboxes telling Jake to set Script Properties SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN / SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN, editor-run shopifyDailyPull, and 'Only then run installShopifyTrigger() (shopify.gs:114)' - all in connectors/gas/shopify.gs, which step 5 of this phase deleted. It directly contradicts the runbook this phase's step 6 added 145 lines above (TODO.md:43-44: 'Confirm SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN/SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN are absent and no shopifyTriggerPull_-era trigger exists'). Step 6's deliverable was the live runbook, so leaving a competing one in the same Active section is precisely the failure it was meant to close. Failure scenario: Jake works the older section, hits a ReferenceError on installShopifyTrigger(), or worse stands the retired 'shopify' channel back up and double-counts online Roastery revenue against shopify_orderapp.

docs/architecture.md contains zero mentions of orderapp, greenbean or shopify_orderapp, and CLAUDE.md's CRITICAL rule still reads 'All ingest flows through doPost -> validateIngest_ -> the two-tab contract ... Never append to a tab outside that path.' greenBeanPull appends to Suppliers via ingestSupplierRows and shopifyWeeklyPull appends to Summary via upsertRows_, both bypassing validateIngest_ entirely (so greenbean rows get no row-level validation - normalizeSupplierRow does none). The bypass is defensible and matches the square.gs precedent, and PRD/schema/api/ingest-contract were all updated, but the two documents that state the rule were not.

Offset paging is not snapshot-stable. The Order app rebuilds report.matched from the live 06_Stock_Intake sheet on every request (Engine_CostApi.js:771 slices by offset/limit), so a row inserted between page 1 and page 2 shifts the window and can return the same intake line twice. greenBeanInvoices_ sums every line unconditionally, so the affected invoice total would be inflated for that run (and the inflated total then drives an affected-week resummarize). Low likelihood at 05:00 Tuesday and it self-corrects on the next pull, but the API returns rowNumber on every row and the collector could dedup on it for free.

orderAppRunStart_ increments the failcount before any token check, and both _impl_ functions return {noToken:true} without calling orderAppRunSuccess_. So if the triggers are installed before ORDER_APP_COST_TOKEN is pasted, the second scheduled run raises an ORANGE calendar alert and every run thereafter re-raises it, indefinitely. The TODO runbook orders token (step 2) before triggers (step 6) so this is correctly sequenced today; flagged because getOrderAppToken_'s 'not set - skipping' log reads as benign and the behaviour is the opposite.

The terminal step 6 has no step6-review.json (steps 0-5 each have one) and no step6-green.log, and every step's review_result is null with no phase-level review-result - i.e. the per-step review gate produced nothing for the last step and the phase-end gate produced nothing at all. tdd_evidence for all 7 steps does carry both red and green, and the suite was independently re-run for this review (1005 passed, 0 failed), so the TDD anchor itself is satisfied; the gap is the review record, matching the known 'phase-end gate skipped' pattern in this repo.
